title: Marsriva MP6 Plus 600W Portable Power Station

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Marsriva MP6 Plus 600W Portable Power Station is a powerful, compact, and reliable portable energy solution designed for home backup, outdoor adventures, camping, emergency preparedness, and professional use. Featuring a 512Wh LiFePO4 battery with a 600W Pure Sine Wave inverter (1200W surge power), it provides stable and clean electricity for sensitive electronic devices such as laptops, desktop PCs, networking equipment, TVs, CPAP machines, drones, cameras, mini refrigerators, LED lights, and other essential appliances.


Built with advanced LiFePO4 battery technology, the MP6 Plus delivers over 3,000 charge cycles, ensuring exceptional durability, enhanced safety, and long-lasting performance. Whether you're facing a power outage or exploring off-grid locations, this portable power station offers dependable backup power whenever you need it.


The Marsriva MP6 Plus supports ultra-fast AC charging, allowing the battery to reach approximately 90% capacity in just one hour, minimizing downtime. It also features an integrated MPPT solar charge controller, enabling efficient charging through compatible solar panels for eco-friendly off-grid power generation.


Designed for maximum versatility, the power station includes multiple output ports, including Pure Sine Wave AC outlets, USB-C PD ports, USB-A Quick Charge ports, and DC outputs, allowing you to charge and power several devices simultaneously. Its intelligent Battery Management System (BMS) provides comprehensive protection against overcharging, over-discharging, overheating, overload, and short circuits.


With its lightweight, portable design and quiet operation, the Marsriva MP6 Plus 600W Portable Power Station is an excellent choice for homes, offices, outdoor camping, photography, RV travel, field operations, emergency backup, and disaster preparedness.


Choose OTECH BD for genuine Marsriva portable power stations at competitive prices in Bangladesh with professional customer support and reliable after-sales service.


Key Features


  • 600W Pure Sine Wave Inverter (1200W Peak Power)
  • 512Wh High-Capacity LiFePO4 Battery
  • Long Battery Life with 3,000+ Charge Cycles
  • Ultra-Fast AC Charging (Up to 90% in Around 1 Hour)
  • Built-in MPPT Solar Charging Controller
  • Multiple Charging Outputs (AC, USB-C PD, USB-A QC & DC)
  • Intelligent Battery Management System (BMS)
  • Quiet, Safe & Energy-Efficient Operation
  • Compact and Portable Design
  • Ideal for Home Backup, Camping, Travel, RV, Office & Emergency Power
